title: Weight Regain and Cardiometabolic Effects After Withdrawal of Semaglutide: The STEP 1 Trial Extension

key_findings.claim: Participants regained two-thirds (67%) of their prior weight loss within one year of treatment withdrawal without lifestyle tapering
key_findings.citation_location: Wilding et al., Diabetes Obes Metab 2022;24(8):1553-1564, Primary Extension Outcome
key_findings.clinical_interpretation: Proof that weight rebound is biological, requiring Steer's structured doctor-led exit off-ramp to recalibrate the set-point.

key_findings.claim: Cardiometabolic improvements in blood pressure, HbA1c, and fasting lipids reverted toward baseline following abrupt medication cessation
key_findings.clinical_interpretation: Sustained metabolic health demands long-term habit formation rather than isolated quick-fix treatments.
